summary: Guarded callback dispatch with longjmp recovery: loads the callback pointer stored at a1+0x40 (offset 0x40); when non-null, invokes it with (a1, a2). Then unwinds through LongjmpMSVCCRT(a1, 1) (0x0058A770) before dispatching (a1, a2) to CallbackDispatch as the return value. Shared recovery/dispatch trampoline reused by 15 callers across stream and buffer code; structural twin of GuardedFunctionDispatch (00486aa0) per prelabel.

operations.description: Load callback v2 from the function pointer stored at a1+0x40 (offset 0x40).
If v2 is non-null, the stored callback is invoked.
Invoke the stored callback v2(a1, a2).
Dispatch (a1, a2) to CallbackDispatch as the final return value.

unresolved: CallbackDispatch is named in the raw source but has no callee evidence ref; its target address is absent from the packet callee list.
LongjmpMSVCCRT unwinds to a saved setjmp frame; the recovery context and the meaning of the value 1 are unknown.
The context type behind a1 (holding the callback slot at offset 0x40) is unknown; the trampoline is shared by 15 callers.
